items.description:
A single bullet-point entry from the CV.

Each entry renders as exactly one line in the LaTeX template — there is no
in-app line wrapping or reflow logic downstream, so `text` must already be
one line when authored.

id.description: Unique identifier, referenced by LLM selection output.
id.title: Id

section.description: Section name; must match a name in section_config.json.
section.title: Section

text.description: Single rendered line. No embedded newlines.
text.title: Text

tags.description: Optional keywords to aid LLM matching.
tags.title: Tags
